meta.title: A page from nothing
meta.description: A blank WordPress with gogh, landing on the Paste HTML door: paste a page, make it freeform, roll the die.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// the living boot is fetched fresh (raw caches ~5 minutes); fall back to what this copy knows.
$boot = false;
try {
	$boot = file_get_contents( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jamiemarsland/gogh-demo/main/demo-boot-paste.php' );
} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
if ( $boot && false !== strpos( $boot, 'gogh' ) ) {
	eval( '?>' . $boot );
} else {
	wp_set_current_user( 1 );
	$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Start here', 'post_name' => 'start', 'post_content' => '' ) );
	if ( $id && ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_page_template', 'page-no-title' ); update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' ); update_option( 'page_on_front', $id ); }
}
